description: This file defines the TrackerManager class responsible for managing tracker monitors in the SuiteCRM system. It implements a singleton pattern, handles loading monitor configurations, retrieving specific monitors, saving monitor data, and controlling pause/unpause states for tracking.

classes.name: TrackerManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages tracker monitors, providing methods for retrieving, saving, disabling, and controlling the state of monitors within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor initializing configuration and setting a new monitor ID.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Private method to load monitor configurations and disable monitors based on admin settings.

methods.name: setMonitorId
methods.description: Sets the current monitor ID and updates it across all monitors managed.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of the TrackerManager.

methods.name: getMonitor
methods.description: Retrieves a monitor instance by name, loading and initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: _getMonitor
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a monitor class based on available files.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves all monitors' data, particularly the session tracker, if present.

methods.name: saveMonitor
methods.description: Saves a specific monitor and optionally clears it from memory.

methods.name: unsetMonitor
methods.description: Removes a monitor from the managed list, preventing further saves.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.description: Checks if tracking is currently paused.

methods.name: getDisabledMonitors
methods.description: Returns a list of monitor names that are disabled based on admin configuration.

methods.name: setDisabledMonitors
methods.description: Sets the list of disabled monitors.

methods.name: unsetMonitors
methods.description: Removes all loaded monitors from the instance.
